notes.title: New Content Update: Floppy Knights v2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/4bbdfd2bb2cd65ab589af43225a9d1407cec3e2b.png[/img]

Surprise!! The final free update for Floppy Knights is here - we’ve got new playable characters, assist mode options, and lots and lots of slimes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/cf13c64f5829f1734b166805d3fb02654bffcdc6.png[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
Who's the hero now? We’re back with our favorite rivals-turned-frenemies Alex and Snarlton! To recover from her devastating loss in the Toggle Town Gadget Cup, Alex is ready to prove her superiority with her new and improved slimes… 

[list]
[*] [b]Play as Alex & Snarlton[/b] in a brand new Side Quest episode, including 4 story levels and 4 Challenge Levels
[*] A brand new set of [b]Slime cards [/b]to use during the Side Quest - Complete the episode to unlock them all and use them in any of your decks in the base game
[*] Additional cards for Plants, Monsters, Hooligans, and Prototype rewarded from beating Challenge Levels
[/list]

[b]Slime Time[/b], the final set of Side Quest DLC, unlocks after beating the Steelshore Coast finale (level 6-4). 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
We’ve added a few [b]Assist Mode[/b] options for players looking for a leg up while playing Floppy Knights. Turn on one of these options for a little help, or hit all three for a much more relaxing experience!

[list]
[*] Novice Knight - Start each turn with +1 Energy, Units gain +1 ATK and Enemies have half HP
[*] Energy Booster - Start each turn with +2 Energy
[*] Second Chance - Once per level, when a Commander is defeated, instead set its HP to 1 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/c2af1dde5e0f6ed4c1c8865329480e7368a0892d.png[/img]

You can access these options from the title screen at any time. 

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resized textures on certain platforms and improved resource loading to reduce load times and improve overall gameplay performance
[*] Improvements to move range calculation to improve performance during battles
[*] Reduced the amount of screen tearing during some players may see during map scrolling
[*] A short hitch when pressing TAKE button on reward screen has been resolved 
[*] Resolved the short delay on the CHOOSE YOUR DISK screen
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Copy adjustment on Write That Down to clarify Prototype units keep their buffs on return 
[*] Changed a spawner in level 5-2 where an enemy could take a turn immediately after spawning in, which was inconsistent from other levels
[*] HP nerf to Ice Goopers
[*] Call For Backup can no longer be played on enemy spawners or button tiles
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Roots card, which made certain challenge levels too challenging 
[*] Resolved an issue causing a soft lock during level 7-2 narrative scene when playing in Simplified Chinese 
[*] Prevented a soft lock that was possible during the Monster Deck tutorial
[*] Units with Protection or Resist buffs can no longer survive glitch tiles
[*] Fixed an issue causing some status effect icons (e.g. invincibility, poison) to appear over units for the incorrect amount of turns
[*] Players can now use up/down on controllers as expected  in the Side Quest menu to jump between episodes 
[*] Resolved a soft lock caused by playing Lights Out on some enemy spawners
[*] Big bosses are now correctly immune to poison and slimed status 
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Single Use Deployment Zones from being removed from the map after playing a unit
[*] Challenge Levels tooltip now appears correctly on the World Map
[*] Addressed text coloring inconsistencies on upgraded versions of cards to make the upgraded effects more clear 
[*] Fixed a bug causing Upsell card action to fail
[*] Added some missing tooltips on a handful of cards
[*] Fixed some edge case issues with Invisibility causing some enemies to ignore the player’s status
[*] Resolved an edge case issue causing the Sort button to break in Deckbuilding menu 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could unintentionally select 2 cards while playing Scrap Paper
[*] Removed a confusing green arrow from Concoctor units
[*] Addressed an issue where playing Cross Pollinate could confuse enemy AI
[*] Pocket Sand now correctly reduces enemy ATK by 1
[*] Various small layering issues have been resolved
[/list]

[h1]Localization Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos in the language selection menu for Simplified and Traditional Chinese
[*] Lava Giant Fingers, Felix’s Drill, and Spectral Runes are now properly localized 
[*] Fixed a typo for the Russian Floppy Knights logo on the title screen
[*] Fixed a localization issue causing some character names to appear in English instead of Japanese / LATAM
[*] Blast Processing now has the correct localization copy for Spanish
[*] Solved an issue causing stat buff pop ups to appear in English only for several languages
[*] Adjusted Troublemaker’s name in several languages to better fit inside the card header 
[*] Various other minor localization errors have been resolved
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Side Quest playtesters and addl writer to credits
[/list]

On behalf of the whole Floppy Knights team, I want to thank everyone who’s picked up the game, shared it with a friend, and especially those of you who have been helping us playtest the secret builds in our Discord. We’ve added so much fun content since the original release back in May, and we couldn’t have pulled it off without that support! 

And with that, we’re going to take a well earned holiday break to recharge. We hope you enjoy the update, and have a good rest of 2022!

notes.title: v1.1.2 Patch - Fast Move Option
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, thank you so much to everyone who picked up Floppy Knights on launch week! We’re thrilled with the reception, and have been hard at work fixing up some high priority bugs and adjustments. Here's what's new:

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*]We added an option into the setting menu for “[b]Fast Move[/b]” which increases the speed of unit movement by 3x. For players looking to speed up enemy turns, this oughta help! Please note that this feature is in Beta, and may cause unexpected issues… if you see anything, please let us know!
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
The following changes were made to card actions to prevent infinite loop exploits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/98ef73dba966a855dcfc0c2ccce5e9993425eecb.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Transplant[/b] - Heal reduced from 2 to 1
[*][b]Transplant +[/b] - Heal reduced from 3 to 2
[*][b]Sunshine[/b] - Energy gain changed to be awarded on the next turn rather than immediately (no changes to number of cards drawn)*
[*][b]Sunshine +[/b] - Energy gain changed to be awarded on the next turn rather than immediately (no changes to number of cards drawn)
[*][b]Psych Up[/b] - Self-Damage increased from 1 to 2
[*][b]Devilish Deal[/b] - Self-Damage increased from 1 to 2
[/list]
[i](*Shoutout to DolphinChemist for beating the final boss in 1 turn)[/i]

[list]
[*] When selecting Retry from the Lose screen, the narrative scenes will automatically be skipped when starting the level again
[*] Minor updates to card copy for better player understanding
[*] Fixed some typos 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues with “Hold the objective for 2 turns” levels, including a soft lock, the win condition triggering at the wrong time, and the countdown resetting 
[*] The “Let’s Get Floppy” achievement is now working - if you beat all levels in Episode 7, you should receive this automatically after loading your save file
[*] Corrected a calculation that was showing some enemies' attack ranges incorrectly
[*] Improvements to enemy AI that prevented some enemies from activating when player units are in range
[*] Resolved an issue where the Pain and Gain card action would not reward the player with a card or energy if the unit that received damage was destroyed
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues We’re Working On[/h2]
[list]
[*] There’s a memory leak causing lag / stuttering when playing for long sessions, for now quitting the app and restarting will improve performance
[*] We’re aware of an exploit that allows the player to accidentally lock the wrong commander into their decks… this will unfortunately require a save data reset as a work around, for now make sure you aren’t button mashing in the Deckbuilding menu
[/list]

There are other bugs we're tracking but we wanted to highlight these as our [b]highest priorities[/b]! They will require quite a bit of testing to ensure they don’t break anything else... we appreciate everyone’s patience, as we’re a small team, and very sleepy this week!

Last thing: If you're enjoying the game, [b]please consider leaving a review[/b]! This helps us in so many ways, and keeps us extra motivated to keep improving and supporting Floppy Knights. Have a great weekend, and thanks for playing!

- Corey & Rose City Games

notes.title: Q&A: Challenge Levels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/0ec97e8a23874797d2f868907b3ad976b1965e86.png[/img]

When creating Floppy Knights, we wanted to keep the game approachable for players who are new to tactics games, but we also wanted to incorporate something special for tactics veterans. So, we added [b]challenge levels[/b]— remixes of existing levels (with more rewards!) 

Designing each level was a fun and interesting process because we wanted to encourage players to try new card combinations and strategies they might not have thought about before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/47d4b784c09c2df7efe57428b9a1f51f14dce4e0.gif[/img]

Feeling up to the challenge? First, let’s cover some of the basics:

[b]Q: What are challenge levels?[/b]
A: Challenge levels are remixes of existing levels with unique twists, like beating a level in one turn, putting the commander crown on normal units, giving you an army of Succulent Kickers, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/0e21b60a9cc60bdcc64d3aa89e07338e58b076ef.gif[/img]

[b]Q: How do you unlock challenge levels?[/b]
A: After you complete an episode in Floppy Knights, you unlock one batch of challenge levels for that episode. That adds up to 24 challenge levels total!

[b]Q: Can I choose which deck I use? [/b]
A: Nope! You will get a predetermined set of cards that you need to complete each challenge with. This pushes you to think differently and try out new card strategies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/f8933982b32797863886485ab05c41ee33132c1a.gif[/img]

[b]Q: What kinds of rewards can I get from completing a challenge level?[/b]
A: By completing these levels, you’ll earn more BigCoin you can spend in the Workshop to buy some of the coolest cards in the game. Oh, and bragging rights, of course :)

[b]Q: Do I have to play the challenge levels to progress in the game?[/b]
A: They’re totally optional, but if you run out of BigCoin to spend or you’re feeling stuck on a level and need some deckbuilding inspiration, you may want to try out a few challenge levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/4c98834153ddb8e7182387c7ceef96cb4d5f9172.gif[/img]

[b]Q: Can we see a preview of some of the challenge levels?[/b]
A: Yes — we’ll be streaming some of our favorite challenge levels 24/7 right here on our Steam page starting tomorrow, May 17, and everyday through launch!

Still have questions for us? Let us know below!

notes.title: Controller Support Available at Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/700e95d4bf8ee1a49fa6962f92e3472d57251328.png[/img]

One question we hear a lot is, “Will Floppy Knights have controller support?” 

Our answer: [b]YES! Floppy Knights will support all major gamepads at launch.[/b]

Designing the control scheme was an interesting challenge. There were plenty of tactics games and card games to riff off of... but not a lot that combine both genres! We wanted playing with a gamepad to feel as intuitive and elegant as possible, and after a lot of research and playtesting, we landed on something that we’re really excited about. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/1779bc8542d8c21c3185d8a5cc7e87369a73ee5b.png[/img]

One feature we knew we needed was letting players easily swap between units across the battlefield by pressing the shoulder buttons. This comes in handy when you’re playing on a larger map. Alternatively, you can use the R stick to navigate around the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/0ef2a746f6eb1d9cf0649f8731c5463f4286e3f6.gif[/img]

To avoid a lot of unnecessary scrolling, you can quickly switch between the map and card table with the press of a button. 
(Fun fact: Mario Maker was one of our initial inspirations for how to quickly switch cursor positions!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/d7d9f8044a3da56d212a9d04a0f07fa84da7f394.gif[/img]

Another thing that was really important to us when designing the control scheme was making sure you never lose sight of where your cursor is. As a result, you can use a combination of controls to navigate the map, select cards and units, and learn more about enemies - all without missing a beat. It was quite the challenge, but we’re excited to hear what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/00077fccbae4673af35008d29ed52773001eaac2.gif[/img]

Time for us to get back to work as we gear up for launch! We’ll keep you posted with another dev update real soon~

[b]Reminder! Floppy Knights launches on May 24th.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/2a0cbed4f66c04b95540a788e49d0d0130731efa.png[/img]

notes.title: Floppy Knights Release Update
notes.content:
[h3]The end of 2020 is upon us! Before we head out for our holiday break, we wanted to throw down a whole slew of updates for you to enjoy. [/h3]

First off, due to the numerous challenges that this year brought, we’ve chosen to delay the release of the game until 2021. Our team has spent almost all of 2020 working remotely, which has been a big adjustment for us. Life -- for everyone -- in the midst of the pandemic has been tough, and a big priority of ours is to make sure our team stays safe. We want to make the best game possible, but we also don’t want to push too hard and burn out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/8729c66ed4b92908372bdae20eebabb59ea50eff.gif[/img]

We’re a small team with multiple projects, and it’s important to us that each game gets the time and energy it deserves without asking our teammates to push too hard to meet the earlier release plans. We also haven’t had the opportunities to playtest as much as we would have liked, with quarantine leaving us unable to attend local meet-ups and festivals, so having more time will allow us to garner better feedback online and help us make Floppy Knights feel great.

In order to make this extended timeline work, we have some exciting new partners helping out- more on that a little later. But, we are certain this delay will allow us to make the game even better, with more crafty card combos and floppier Knights! We appreciate everyone’s understanding, and promise it’ll be worth the wait.

[h2]New Teaser + Screenshots[/h2]

To give you a taste of what’s in store, we’ve prepared a quick teaser that shows a world beyond verdant farmland and veggie-stealing goblins. We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Floppy Knights Vibe Check!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/6db6d08615ea801c89bfbedf69db387bc1866ae8.png[/img]

[i]Wowee, it’s been a busy two weeks at Rose City Games. Portland, where the team is based, has been dealing with wildfires and lots of smoke in the last week, and as some of you reached out to ask, we first and foremost wanted to let you know that we’re doing okay. We did take things a bit slower last week as we were all keeping one eye out on the news, but we still have some updates to share![/i]

[h3][b]Vibe Check![/b][/h3]

How’re your [b]Floppy Knights[/b] feeling? It’s going to be so much easier to tell with our latest update! We’ve been making lots of small tweaks and updates to battle visual effects, and here’s a quick summary of what you can expect to see when buffing your units (or, ahem...if you happen to take damage in various ways, but we won’t focus on that ;) ). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/410bd2b22fddaa86869feb2b039fafe0b7fdc5dd.gif[/img]

[h3][b]All the small things...[/b][/h3]

We’ve also made visual updates to other actions during battle! When using cards like [b]Grow[/b], for example, the effect of the card is more clearly indicated with a green number, and the numbers made easier to distinguish with an orange stroke. All small details that add up to generally quicker ways to read and interpret all the info you have at hand! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/87179b6e3379f69f27c436b61a5c4564559e0629.gif[/img]

[h3][b]...and not so small things![/b][/h3]

In addition to those small -- but still impactful -- tweaks, we’ve been doing some pretty substantial redesign on once familiar levels! In addition to new battlefield layouts, you may notice a couple of new objects on the field… our game designer, [b]Christian[/b], has had some fun creating more surprises for you to encounter in the game. ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/b15c968f4056480173e0cffd054c7440ae8ec1a4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]It’s Science![/b][/h3]

We’ve also been working on fortifying the decks with new cards, based on all of the design changes that [b]Christian’s[/b] been tweeting about lately. The hardest part? You may think it’s balancing our card generation system with level design and maintaining synergy among a million other game dev things. Instead it’s more like... well... I’ll let this super scientific graph do all the talking: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/d1531fec82c26a4ae48da55805b2c48789ec106c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hope you're all staying safe and well![/b][/h3]

We’ll keep trucking on development, and we hope that you all are staying safe and well, too! As always, please don’t hesitate to keep in touch -- we’re on [url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][b]Discord[/b][/url] as well as [url=https://twitter.com/floppyknights][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/770a16d2b9c9c7f2d55e5f3faa36fa1ea0849887.jpg[/img][/url]

Talk soon,

[b]💾 Jenny and the Floppy Knights team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057800/

[h3][b]Feelin’ hot, hot, HOT[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/5a171574b78a8083c0c91830dee80d368d8ce50c.gif[/img]

[url=http://pixelpopfestival.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/f16ee51f94b44d1845643a3578d20ede739c33d1.png[/img][/url]

[b]More Heat To Come[/b]

The fun's never over, and there's a bunch of stuff we can't wait to talk to you about in our coming updates. Until then, keep a watch on our [url=https://twitter.com/floppyknights][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and make sure you join our lovely community on [url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][b]Discord[/b][/url].

[url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/10732dfcf0d3e3a07115c140c142981f7597ede8.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/bdff5fee9d3dd483b569f634b8d6ca6a6b7b5dbb.png[/img]

Have you all had a chance to start brainstorming your summertime [b]Floppy Knights[/b]? We’re excited to see what you all create! If you haven’t gotten on board with our [url=https://www.floppyknights.com/summersciencefair][b]fan art contest[/b][/url], now’s the time. 

[url=https://www.floppyknights.com/summersciencefair][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/8e197a40e51c2f194bdd2423e32b31ff1ba7a90d.gif[/img][/url]

While you’re all crafting and getting creative, we’re also working on more [b]Floppy Knights[/b] development. Read on to see what we’ve been up to these past couple of weeks:  

[h3][b]Phoebe, Clean Your Room![/b][/h3]

There are quite a few more episodes and areas getting added right now as we zoom from the alpha and demo into Beta! The tutorial that we teased during the demo is getting revamped to take place in [b]Phoebe’s[/b] room. Here’s a quick peek at some of knick-knacks you’ll see when learning how to lead your [b]Floppy Knights[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/bd3225ae97003a5b8fe4aa865539021f5fb82ade.png[/img]

[h3][b]Status: Poisoned! [/b][/h3]

So, you’ve sent [b]Spitunia[/b] over to use [b]Poison Shot[/b] on a goblin… and up until now, there wasn’t any way to tell they were actually poisoned. Up until now! Check out this poor lil fella: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/2556e73c55562449bc3892d5b18e26d7eddd0daa.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Mooooooove on over![/b][/h3]

As we continue to implement feedback based on what we received during the [b]Steam Game Festival[/b] demo period, we’re continuing to explore movement adjustments. A couple of weeks ago, we mentioned adjusting values of movement cards so that it’s cheaper, which allows you to move more. 

We tested it, and while it worked, it was an inelegant solution! So [b]Christian[/b], our game designer, played with it a bit more, and came up with a NEW movement system, based on inherent movement values for each unit! [url=https://twitter.com/PerpetualRaine/status/1283884830950752256?s=20][b]Check out this thread[/b][/url] to get all the details.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://twitter.com/PerpetualRaine/status/1283884830950752256?s=20][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/6ad640910592889b049922b0b3a47e665e1aa873.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Paint by [strike]Numbers[/strike] Goblins[/b][/h3]

Our programmer, [b]Nic[/b], came up with a speedy way to get enemies placed on the maps! Meet: Goblin brush! Don’t worry, we’ll [b]try[/b] not to get over-eager and just flood all the maps with goblins.

While I can’t tell you about the amazingly cool [b][REDACTED][/b] or the super sneaky and suspicious-looking [b][REDACTED][/b] … I can show you this wonderfully mischievous character, ready to steal your heart! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/2b3116b71d491827a6a37dcafb389bdbdad4d236.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Busy, Busy![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Floppy Knights Demo @ Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/a8dc7c9a45d68d9192b6902d9ae51a63b5c5a70d.png[/img]


What's [b]Floppy Knights[/b], you might ask? A [b]deck-building, sword-swinging, tactical adventure[/b], where tangible projections are summoned from floppy disks, helping our hero [b]Phoebe[/b], and her trusty bionic arm best friend, [b]Carlton[/b], earn cash and perhaps even save the world in the process.

We're very excited for you to try out our demo and are equally eager to hear how you feel about it. Since it's we're pretty much in the alpha stages, we've [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1057800/view/2369404245757733067]detailed here[/url] some of the bugs that you can find and how you can best provide us with feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/e8319f5f7942210f0ad20585fd1a7be30bd0a199.gif[/img]


The demo totals [b]5 levels[/b] (one tutorial level included), which will last you for about [b]45 minutes[/b] or so, depending on how well you play your cards. Oh and if you like it, we'd really appreciate you wishlisting it to stay updated with what's new to come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057800/

[h3][b]Need a short history lesson?[/b][/h3]

Hey, we're [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rosecitygames]Rose City Games[/url][/b], an independent game studio based out of Portland, Oregon! You might ask yourself, how did [b]Floppy Knights[/b] came to be? Here's the short explanation:

This game was originally concepted by [b]Marlowe Dobbe[/b] (our talented creative lead, artist & animator, you might know her from Dicey Dungeons) in the same concept jam that [b]Rose City[/b] also began the ideas for our two previous games: [b]The World Next Door[/b] and [b]Cat Lady[/b]! 

At this concept jam, which was about two years ago, we know we really liked this idea, but ended up sitting on it for a while, while we worked on our other two titles first. The time spent sitting on this concept was valuable, though: as we continued progress with [b]The World Next Door[/b] and [b]Cat Lady[/b], Marlowe was able to continue developing the world and it’s characters. While the original pitch for this was focused more on the IP, we realized we wanted to do something tactics-related (similar to Advance Wars). 

We had the opportunity to work with Intel creating developer tools, and with the funding obtained from that, we were able to begin the initial prototypes for [b]Floppy Knights[/b]. During Fall 2019, we also created a paper prototype of the game, taking it to feedback nights with our local indie game community to begin receiving feedback on the gameplay. At [b]PAX West 2019[/b], we began our search for a publisher, and are happy to share that we’re currently working with [url=https://thoseawesomeguys.com/][b]Those Awesome Guys[/b][/url] to bring [b]Floppy Knights[/b] fully to life!

Hope you enjoy playing in the world of [b]Floppy Knights[/b] as much as we enjoy bringing it to life. Oh and, let us know what you think! We'd appreciate [url=https://forms.gle/8vHybgG9qMsMbPjq6]your feedback[/url].

💾 Jenny + the Floppy Knights Team

notes.title: Floppy Knights Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
We can’t believe it’s finally time for you all to try out the [b]Floppy Knights Demo[/b]! We’re all sorts of nervous and excited that this day has arrived (but mostly excited). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/e795c86bb21799e3593f3c75cc292965b3c5fb42.gif[/img]


As you may have seen from the title screen, [b]Floppy Knights[/b] is still in the “Alpha” stages of development. Our team worked hard to iron out as much as we could in time for the digital events, but we expect that some of you will likely notice bugs while playing. 

Here are a few issues we know about:

[list]
[*] The game’s file size is currently pretty large; we’ll be optimizing before release! 
[*] The “slow” status effect is currently not working correctly. 
[*] You can sometimes attack an unoccupied tile after destroying an enemy. 
[*] Excessive fast-clicking on cards and buttons can sometimes stage your unit's attack card, causing it to get stuck in staging for the remainder of the round (which kind of lets you cheat...ssshhh).
[*] Using “Grow” on a card that’s already been discounted (e.g. with “Light Up”) may cause that card to lose its discounted energy cost.
[*] The Payback ability can counter attack enemies at any range. Kinda OP, right?. 
[*] Various minor visual and audio bugs (naturally). 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/adc11b34598f232497b292e7663e5532298a3563.png[/img]


If you notice anything else, please let us know ~ we have a feedback form available [url=https://forms.gle/8vHybgG9qMsMbPjq6][b]here[/b][/url]. 

You can also [url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][b]pop into our Discord[/b][/url] to talk with us and provide any comments and feedback there. We also appreciate cheesy puns and pictures of your pets, so feel free to drop those in anytime. 😉

Oh! And if you haven’t already wishlisted the game, we’d love it if you did:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057800/

Thanks for checking out [b]Floppy Knights[/b]! We hope you have a great time playing!

notes.title: Reshuffling the Combat System!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/012d46b09063601788e119e45d8ce160dbf89321.png[/img]

It’s been an especially exciting couple of weeks for us on Team Floppy Knights, since we’ve been making HUGE changes to the game, namely with its battle system, along with lots of progress on other areas of the game.


[h3][b]Shuffle the Deck: Combat Updates Incoming![/b][/h3]

A refreshed battle system is something we’ve been teasing and discussing on Twitter, and we’re finally able to share more! Last week, our game designer, Christian, put out a design thread describing some of the issues that have become apparent in our original battle system. One of the big areas we wanted to improve? The pacing, especially in the larger battles, since they were feeling a tad slow. If you wanna see the details, read more to see why:

[url=https://twitter.com/PerpetualRaine/status/1250862568878424074?s=20][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/986bb96df25fd310f7add00256adefd06dc87eff.png[/img][/url]

Long story short? Instead of tying attacks to cards and resources, all units have one attack they can use every turn, which speeds up battles and creates some room for very interesting strategies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/aecf60c44819e978d2f16c5056e6345adf97793a.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Status Effect Pop-Ups[/b][/h3]

The more we add to combat, the more we also work on how to communicate all the info you need to know. While we’re still working on exactly the right way to display all this info, this week, we’ve played with it popping up overhead on your units, so you can hover over whenever you want to check what’s going on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/4a60e9b75b44274fd74fe6850d1268b0f8f98ce6.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Keepin’ Track of Attacks[/b][/h3]

To help even more with planning, another version of these pop-ups also will potentially be seen in instances like right before attacking! That way, you can figure out exactly what happens with the action you’re about to take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/1813b981c56bf45d89145ebc8c72a512512443b9.png[/img]

[h3][b]Adding that JUICE![/b][/h3]

In our continued progress on making cards seem weighter and animations even juicer, we’ve got cards slamming down to really give you that UMPH! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/969c6ab46ee6719929959411336a405191b5b39a.gif[/img]


[h3][b]A Little Bit of This, A Little Bit of That[/b][/h3]

In addition to these bigger shifts and additions, we’ve done lots of other bits of clean-up and fixing. Things like updating the tiles on the maps (which now include more lovely flowers and juuuust a bit more real estate for the map) as well as implementing lots of new bleeps, boops, and bops with the SFX in the game to match the additional shine we’re putting on all the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/92100dd129ce6ce1efd21de7eba45dbbd2f262f4.gif[/img]


[h3]Until our next update, find us on [url=http://discord.gg/floppyknights][b]Discord[/b][/url] or [url=http://twitter.com/floppyknights][b]Twitter[/b][/url], and come say hi![/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/floppyknights][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/9b54b1a306504a3280f20572664aeeb5aee13a32.jpg[/img][/url]

‘Till next time!

[b]💾 Jenny + Team Floppy Knights [/b]

notes.title: Floppy Knights' PAX East 2020 Extravaganza! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/97900c90c4ec79200526c15ec02db7ce85009e59.png[/img]

First and foremost, we want to thank everyone for stopping by our booth. Seeing so many friendly faces swooning over [b]Floppy Knights[/b] made us all kinds of giddy 🤗. It was the perfect motivator for the team, and we’re even more excited about continuing our progress on the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/71436e15c505e5753b1820736ea4d9c59cc29f49.jpg[/img]

While this was the first time [b]Floppy Knights[/b] attended such a big event, this was also our second [b]PAX East[/b] as a studio, which made setting up a breeze! With our lil' succulent kicker buddies in tow, we were able to set up our booth without any hitches… and we even had time for a mini dance party:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fWAnF0mVOCQRdAeCsf/source.gif[/img]

As you might’ve been able to guess, we were both excited and juuust a little bit nervous to see what folks thought of the game (it was [b]Floppy Knights’[/b] first [b]PAX[/b] and [b]IMB[/b] feature, after all!) We weren’t disappointed: folks of all ages seemed to love the bright colors and fun characters ✨, and we had multiple occasions where kids would literately run up to the booth, ready to play. As a team, we all definitely agreed that our favorite moments were whenever we saw a family gather around the monitor to enjoy the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/b036270fc0a26c2f4ebe0f413421d329027e72d0.jpg[/img]

It was really wonderful to meet you all and catch sight of some first impressions and initial reactions to our knights ⚔️ out in the wild. Rest assured that come summer, we will be ready to show you even more of what the world of [b]Floppy Knights[/b] has to offer. Oh, and get ready to expand your collection: we’ve got more cards in the making! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36805795/72caf8f2b125cc5198f385f3caf8f69ca22e9c37.jpg[/img]
